nodes.label: Always-On Graphify Guidance
nodes.rationale: Use the installed Graphify workflow by default for codebase questions and retain graph outputs through incremental updates.

nodes.label: Graphify Semantic Refresh Requirement
nodes.rationale: After changing plans, ADRs, threat models, READMEs, or other documents, semantic extraction must be refreshed because graphify update alone only refreshes code AST.

nodes.label: Android Local RAG Stack
nodes.rationale: Provides offline document-grounded answers without cloud upload or a second LLM runtime.

nodes.label: Answerability Cascade
nodes.rationale: Exact anchors are accepted, low-signal cases are rejected, and remaining candidates require a local answerability classifier; unavailable classifiers fail closed.

nodes.label: Hybrid Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Combines dense and lexical retrieval because exact terms are unreliable with vector search alone.

nodes.label: llama.cpp-omni Source Dependency
nodes.rationale: Resolve a shared llama.cpp-omni source tree and fail configuration when its CMake project is absent.

nodes.label: Graphify Completion Check
nodes.rationale: Before completing a local task, graphify check-update must identify pending semantic work; failed or omitted documents cannot be stamped current.

nodes.label: Atomic Conversation Archive
nodes.rationale: A bounded versioned archive is atomically persisted and corrupt data fails closed to a fresh session.

nodes.label: MiniCPM Native Shared Library
nodes.rationale: Build llama_jni.cpp and omni_jni.cpp as the Android native bridge.

nodes.label: Public Guard Prequalification
nodes.rationale: Licensed public holdouts validate the scoring pipeline but cannot qualify the production Answerability profile; failing public metrics keep the profile null.

nodes.label: Selective Query Routing
nodes.source_location: Final Data Flow and State Machine; Task 1
nodes.rationale: Ordinary chat bypasses retrieval, while knowledge-related queries use lexical and optional dense retrieval.

nodes.label: Recoverable Indexing Worker Chain
nodes.rationale: Ordered workers persist progress and only mark an index READY when chunks, embeddings, and metadata agree.

nodes.label: Serialized Context Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Timeline changes cancel work, reset native context, and replay retained context safely.

nodes.label: Untrusted Document Boundary
nodes.rationale: URIs, metadata, document contents, OCR results, and embedded prompts are untrusted input.

nodes.label: Graphify Scoped Query Protocol
nodes.rationale: Prefer graphify query, path, and explain over broad report reading or raw source browsing when graph data exists.

nodes.label: Native Checkpoint Transaction
nodes.source_location: Final Data Flow and State Machine
nodes.rationale: Temporary RAG prompts branch from a checkpoint and restore stable context after generation.

nodes.label: Stable Application Signing
nodes.rationale: Preserves app-private models, conversations, and knowledge bases during device testing.

nodes.label: Android ABI Configuration
nodes.rationale: Select ARM or x86 GGML architecture, KleidiAI, and OpenMP settings based on Android ABI, with generic CPU fallback.

nodes.label: Real Office Data Isolation
nodes.rationale: Training, calibration, and final test data must have disjoint document IDs and use reviewed redacted records.

nodes.label: Synthetic Guard Dataset
nodes.rationale: Synthetic data validates label and workflow contracts but is insufficient for production qualification.

nodes.label: Ephemeral RAG Evidence
nodes.rationale: Evidence is injected only for the current generation and is not persisted in conversation history or KV cache.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Integrity Validation
nodes.rationale: Inconsistent model or index artifacts are rejected and rebuilt after version, dimension, hash, and SHA-256 checks.

nodes.label: BM25 Cross-Corpus Drift
nodes.rationale: Absolute BM25 values do not transfer across knowledge-base sizes because IDF depends on corpus size and document frequency.

nodes.label: Graphify Incremental Update
nodes.rationale: Run graphify update after code changes to keep the AST-derived graph current without API cost.

nodes.label: Quantized ONNX Guard Export
nodes.rationale: A shared encoder dual-head model is INT8-quantized and its manifest is written only after equivalence and size gates pass.

nodes.label: Role-Specific Message Editing
nodes.rationale: Assistant edits preserve subsequent turns, while user edits truncate subsequent history and regenerate.

nodes.label: Local RAG Experimental Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The application preserves ordinary chat as the fallback whenever retrieval or review cannot be trusted.

nodes.label: Guard v3 Release Boundary
nodes.rationale: Guard v3 is experimental because the frozen INT8 alignment gate failed even though the independent task metrics improved.

nodes.label: Document Isolated Dataset Split
nodes.rationale: Document-level isolation prevents train, calibration, and test leakage.

nodes.label: Conservative Experimental Thresholds
nodes.rationale: A 0.95 threshold limits experimental acceptance while preserving normal-model fallback.
